simulator.metaDescription: Estimate the payment, total cost and effective rate of a lease in Morocco, and compare it with a bank loan or a cash purchase.
simulator.title: What does your lease really cost?
simulator.subtitle: Payment, total cost, effective rate and comparison with a bank loan or a cash purchase, calculated live. Real offers then come from lessors.
simulator.rateHint: Editable assumption: the real rate depends on the lessor and your application.
simulator.residualHint: Paid at the end of the lease
simulator.inconsistent: Inconsistent inputs: the first payment and the residual value exceed the financed amount.
simulator.disclaimer: Indicative simulation based on your assumptions; it is not an offer. Lease payments are generally deductible and VAT recoverable for a VAT-registered business: check with your accountant.
simulator.compareBody: Present cost at {discount}, net of corporate tax savings at {tax}. Lowest is cheapest.
simulator.outflow: Paid out over the term: {amount} excl. VAT
simulator.compareHypotheses: Assumptions: loan at the same rate, down payment equal to the increased first payment; asset owned at the end in all three cases; straight-line depreciation; VAT recovered; tax saving counted in the month of the expense.

lessorsTeaser.title: Prepared applications that match your appetite
lessorsTeaser.body: {brand} only sends you applications that match your criteria, complete and checked. Success-based fee.

faq.title: What you need to know
faq.body: Status, cost, data, timing: clear answers.

intermediary.a: {brand} is an intermediary in leasing transactions acting under written mandates from leasing companies (Law 103-12). We do not lend money and never handle funds.

free.q: Is it really free for my business?
free.a: Yes. The service is free for businesses, with no commitment: you are free to decline every offer.

decision.q: Who decides to grant the financing?
decision.a: Only the lessor. {brand} prepares and routes the application; it makes no credit decision.

data.a: They are encrypted and only sent to the lessors you accepted, by name, in line with Law 09-08. You can access, correct and request deletion of your data.

lessors.q: How many lessors receive my application?
lessors.a: Usually three to five, selected because their criteria match your need (amount, sector, term, type of equipment). You see their names before accepting.

delay.q: How long until I receive offers?
delay.a: Our target is a lessor response within 72 hours for a complete application. Actual timing depends on each lessor and on your application.

score.q: What is the orientation index for?
score.a: It is an explainable grid that helps route your application to suitable lessors. Orientation index: the decision belongs exclusively to the lessor.

commission.a: By lessors, through a success fee paid when the lease starts, as set in their mandate. It never affects how offers are ranked.

final.title: What would your equipment cost on a lease?
final.body: Simulate in seconds, no sign-up needed.

common.exampleNote: Pre-filled illustrative example; adjust the amounts to your project.

transport.name: Transport and logistics
transport.teaser: Tractors, rigid trucks, semi-trailers, vans: finance your fleet without tying up cash.
transport.metaTitle: Transport and logistics leasing in Morocco
transport.metaDescription: Lease trucks, semi-trailers and vans: one application, several lessor offers compared on total cost.
transport.title: Leasing for transport and logistics
transport.intro: Replacing a tractor or growing a fleet ties up a lot of cash. Leasing spreads the investment over the vehicle's working life.

c1.title: Term and usage
c1.body: Choose the term based on actual use and expected mileage: an overly long term raises the cost with no benefit.

c2.title: New or used
c2.body: Some lessors finance used vehicles; age and condition weigh on the terms.

c3.title: Resale value
c3.body: Good resale value reassures the lessor and can improve the offer.

q1.q: Can several vehicles be financed in one application?
q1.a: Yes: describe them all in your request; each lessor states what it can finance.

q2.a: Yes, a quote or pro forma invoice lets lessors price precisely.

q3.q: Who owns the vehicle during the lease?
q3.a: The lessor; you use it, and you can acquire it at the end by exercising the purchase option.

btp.name: Construction and public works
btp.teaser: Excavators, loaders, cranes, batching plants: machinery financed at the pace of your projects.
btp.metaDescription: Lease excavators, loaders, cranes and site equipment: compare offers from several lessors, for free.
btp.title: Leasing for construction and public works
btp.intro: Construction machinery means large amounts. Leasing preserves your capacity to bid for contracts while equipping your teams.

c1.title: Project seasonality
c1.body: Quarterly or half-yearly payments can match your cash inflows better than monthly ones.

c2.title: Contracts in hand
c2.body: Signed contracts help the lessor assess your repayment capacity.

c3.title: Specialised equipment
c3.body: Very specific machinery is harder to resell: the first payment or residual value may reflect it.

q1.a: Yes, the frequency is discussed with each lessor; the simulator lets you compare.

q2.a: By some lessors, depending on the machine's age, condition and market value.

q3.a: Company documents (trade register, articles, financial statements), the equipment quote and, if possible, your ongoing contracts.

medical.name: Medical and healthcare
medical.teaser: Imaging, operating room, dental practice, laboratory: equip yourself without straining your cash.
medical.metaDescription: Lease imaging, practice and laboratory equipment: one application, several lessor offers compared.
medical.title: Leasing for medical equipment
medical.intro: Clinics, practices and laboratories renew costly equipment that becomes obsolete quickly. Leasing aligns the financing term with the period of use.

c1.title: Technological obsolescence
c1.body: A shorter term lets you renew fast-evolving equipment sooner.

c2.title: Approved supplier
c2.body: A quote from a recognised supplier, with warranty and maintenance, eases the review.

c3.title: Regulated profession
c3.body: Lessors may ask for documents specific to medical practice.

q1.a: Yes, provided it can supply the documents lessors require for its legal form.

q2.a: Some lessors include it or offer it as an option; it then appears in the offer details.

q3.a: Depending on the lessor, installation costs on the quote can be included in the financed amount.

qualified.title: Prepared applications

sla.body: An inbox sorted by time remaining, with a 72-hour response target.

success.title: Success-based fee
success.body: No access fee: a commission paid only when the lease starts, per the grid in your mandate.

security.title: Security and confidentiality
security.body: Two-factor authentication, strict isolation between lessors, an audit log of every view.

steps.s1: We sign a written mandate setting out your criteria and the commission grid.
steps.s2: You receive applications matching your criteria, with the business's consent.
steps.s3: You ask questions in the platform and submit a priced offer, or decline with a reason.
steps.s4: If the business picks your offer, you contract directly with it; {brand} follows up until the lease starts.
